full_prompt_en: A square historical oil painting shows mounted officers in dark ceremonial uniforms against pale mountains and a crowded procession. The upper background opens to a warm gray sky, with steep snow-covered ridges rising behind the figures. Below the ridges, a dense line of smaller soldiers and horses stretches across the middle distance, their individual shapes softened by scale and haze. In the foreground, several officers sit on richly colored horses. The leftmost prominent rider wears a black high-crowned military hat, a dark jacket covered with bright gold braid, white trousers, and black boots. A second rider beside him has a similarly dark uniform and decorated headwear, his body partly overlapped by the powerful black horse in front. A third officer in pale clothing and a tall dark hat appears behind the brown horse at the right. The nearest black horse fills the lower center with glossy dark neck, visible tack, and sharply modeled head. A warm brown horse occupies the right side, its broad shoulder and neck catching light. A red saddle cloth with gold trim shows along the left horse, adding a vivid accent beneath the formal clothing. The riders are tightly arranged, with faces and hat shapes clear but the massed figures behind them more diffuse. Paint moves between smooth modeling on horses and faces, crisp small strokes on gold trim, and softer atmospheric blending in the mountains. Daylight falls from the upper left, illuminating white fabric, brass decoration, and the brown horse while leaving deep folds and the black horse's underside shaded. The overall composition compresses a formal group of riders against a vast pale landscape, balancing dark equestrian masses, gold detail, and distant snowy light.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形历史题材油画描绘穿深色礼服的骑马军官，背景是浅色山峦与拥挤行列。上方背景展开为暖灰天空，陡峭覆雪山脊在人物身后升起。山脊下方，较小的士兵和马匹组成密集队列，横贯中景，单独形体因尺度与雾气而柔化。前景几名军官骑在色彩丰厚的马背上。左侧最显眼的骑手戴高冠黑色军帽，穿饰有明亮金色绳带的深色上衣、白裤和黑靴。他身旁第二名骑手也穿深制服、戴有装饰的帽子，身体部分被前方强壮的黑马遮住。右侧棕马之后，一名穿浅色衣服、戴高深帽的军官露出。最近的黑马以发亮的深色脖颈、可见马具与清楚塑形的头部占据下方中央。暖棕马占据右侧，宽厚肩颈接住光线。左侧马身上露出带金边的红色鞍布，在正式服饰下增添鲜明点缀。骑手排列紧密，面庞与帽形清楚，身后聚集人物则较模糊。颜料在马和脸上的平滑塑形、金色饰边的精细短笔，以及山峦中的柔和大气过渡之间变化。日光从左上落下，照亮白衣、黄铜装饰和棕马，深色衣褶与黑马腹侧则留在阴影中。整体构图把正式骑马群像压缩在辽阔浅色风景前，以深色骑乘体块、金色细节和远处雪光取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: The image has a polished historical oil-painting finish, combining smooth volumetric modeling with fine decorative strokes. Deep black, warm chestnut, muted red, cream, and brass gold gather in a dense foreground, while pale gray and icy blue recede through an atmospheric background. Clear contours hold the nearest overlapping forms together; distance softens into a continuous haze of small marks. Directional daylight picks out upper surfaces, pale fabric-like areas, and metallic details, leaving rounded lower planes in cool shadow. Large masses remain stately and controlled despite intricate surface accents. The overall effect is ceremonial and expansive, with concentrated dark detail set against open mountain-toned light.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有精致的历史油画完成面，平滑体积塑形与细密装饰笔触结合。深黑、暖栗色、低饱和红、奶油与黄铜金聚在密集前景，浅灰与冰蓝则通过大气背景后退。清楚轮廓让近处叠压形体保持整体，远处软化为连续的细小笔迹雾层。定向日光提亮上表面、浅色织物般区域与金属细节，圆钝下表面保留冷阴影。即使表面重音繁复，大体块仍庄重受控。整体效果仪式感强而开阔，以集中的深色细节对照敞开的山色亮光。
theme_en: Mounted officers in dark ceremonial uniforms before pale mountains
theme_zh: 深色礼服骑马军官立于浅色山峦前
name: Horace Vernet
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
